method: R44 rolling league table proxy using cached previous FT results only, 365/90 day points per game, goal differential, rank percentile of teams with observed matches, recent relative points momentum and played counts. Three UTC day lag, same R26 research convention. No true season standings, official deductions, relegation/promotion or motivation claims. Source coverage incomplete; no invented missing values. Prior calendar-year training excludes receipt archive ID targets; same matched cohort across models. No league selection or new strategy gates. Retrospective complement, not tradeable real-time membership. Historical and actual receipts distinct.
